display.label: AWS Network Load Balancer
display.description: Provision Amazon Network Load Balancers (NLB) for high-performance Layer 4 (TCP/UDP/TLS) traffic distribution

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique identifier for the Network Load Balancer, applied as the resource name and map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core load balancer attributes including name, scheme, and IP address type.

fields.label: Load Balancer Name
fields.description: Unique name for the Network Load Balancer (up to 32 alphanumeric characters and hyphens).

validation.pattern_error: Name must be 1-32 alphanumeric characters and hyphens, and cannot start or end with a hyphen.

fields.label: Internal Load Balancer
fields.description: Whether the load balancer is internal (private VPC) or internet-facing (public).

fields.label: IP Address Type
fields.description: The type of IP addresses used by the subnets for your load balancer.

fields.label: Enable Deletion Protection
fields.description: If enabled, protects the load balancer from accidental deletion via the AWS API.

sections.label: Networking & Security
sections.description: VPC, public/private subnets across multiple AZs, and security groups.

fields.label: VPC
fields.description: The VPC in which to deploy the Network Load Balancer.

fields.label: Subnets
fields.description: List of at least two public or private subnets in different Availability Zones.

fields.label: Create Dedicated Security Group
fields.description: Automatically provision a dedicated Security Group for the NLB.

fields.label: Security Group IDs
fields.description: List of existing Security Group IDs to associate with the NLB.

sections.label: Advanced NLB Settings
sections.description: Cross-zone load balancing, client routing policy, and keep-alive settings.

fields.label: Cross-Zone Load Balancing
fields.description: Distribute traffic evenly across all registered targets in all enabled Availability Zones.

fields.label: Client Keep Alive (seconds)
fields.description: Client keep-alive timeout duration in seconds (range: 60 to 604800).

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: User-defined key-value tags to assign to the Network Load Balancer.
